content_of_post_to_answer: Is my constant overthinking caused by anxiety or ADHD?
answer: Overthinking can look similar in anxiety and ADHD, but the engine behind it is often different. Anxiety tends to pull thoughts toward threats and “what ifs,” while ADHD can create a flood of unfinished ideas, connections, and mental noise. The useful question is not just “why am I thinking so much?” but “what pattern does my thinking follow?” I’ve explored this distinction in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The problem is rarely having a busy mind; it is not knowing what kind of busy mind you have.
